tasks.title: Aumet shows missing_credential: auto-login from existing secrets
tasks.brief: supplier-health run 43587871889: pharmaoverseas connected, aumet missing_credential (no saved session in the Worker), although GitHub secrets AUMET_USERNAME and AUMET_PASSWORD exist. Make the Aumet connector create/refresh its session automatically from those existing credentials (same pattern pharmaoverseas uses to stay connected), read-only: login + catalog/search probe only, never carts/orders/POs. Never print secret values. If the Worker needs the credentials as Worker secrets, add a guarded GitHub Actions step that copies them by name (no values in logs). Tests required. No deploy.
tasks.acceptance: Health check reports aumet connected; read-only; tests pass; no secret values logged; no deploy.
